loopIdea: The reel ends on beat 1's tight glare-lit dashboard macro with the amber glow gone dark, so a replay lands on the same framing at the moment it lights up again.
mechanicTruth: Pressure inside a tire rises and falls with the air temperature inside it, roughly one PSI for every ten degrees Fahrenheit, so a tire measured hot off midday asphalt can read right at spec and still be several PSI low when the same tire is measured cold the next morning.
